questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to an upcoming intersection. Prepare for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride beside the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a center turn lane for left turns only. You cannot use this lane for passing or to go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign means yield. Slow down when you approach an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians pass. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on conditions. Adjust your speed when conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a merge ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. It tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to warn of no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. Another road is joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that this road is one-way and you cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns you that you are approaching a railroad crossing. Look for signs of an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way roadways separated by a median. You must stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.
